recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Any remaining publication metadata need for R4 quality-measure usage should be handled in the relevant IG or extension-pack scope, not by restoring the removed core RelatedArtifact fields.
issue_request: FHIR-26690 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested RelatedArtifact.publicationStatus 0..1 code bound required to PublicationStatus plus RelatedArtifact.publicationDate 0..1 date, used only as informational publication metadata and not normally populated when pointing to a FHIR resource.
initial_application: Git commit 8e8720183bd9044c22875a57ffb12babf230c0ff applied the issue by adding the two RelatedArtifact rows and the RelatedArtifactPublicationStatus binding to source/datatypes/relatedartifact.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-50010 is a later Applied/Persuasive R6 decision for the same RelatedArtifact datatype. It explicitly directed removal of publicationDate and publicationStatus, introduced artifact[x], related constraints, reduced relationship types, and added usage guidance. FHIR-I minutes record both the 2020 FHIR-26690 vote and the 2025 FHIR-50010 vote. FHIR-26689 is a companion FHIR-us-qm/R4 extension tracker outside this core reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source/datatypes/relatedartifact.xml and source/metadatatypes.html reflect the later FHIR-50010 model, and source/fhir.ini records the publication fields as R5-to-R6 removals; reintroducing them would be incorrect.
